mainEntity.name: When can I DIY a drywall seam, and when should I hire a professional contractor?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can fix hairline surface cracks yourself if the underlying drywall panels are rigid and firmly attached. However, you should call a general contractor if the drywall flexes when pressed, spans across vaulted ceiling trusses, or accompanies doors that suddenly stick in their frames. Large cracks exceeding one-quarter inch or joint tape pulling off across entire rooms often point to broader framing movement or framing issues. A licensed contractor can assess whether structural backing, panel replacement, or truss clip installation is required before closing and finishing the drywall.
acceptedAnswer.description: DIY works for small, firm surface cracks. Hire a professional if the boards flex, seams gap widely, doors stick, or the joint extends across vaulted framing or load-bearing walls.
